rules.statement: Make any counts or lists of changed members in a pull request description or changelog entry match the diff exactly, and name the members a count covers when it's ambiguous.
rules.why: When the numbers in a description don't match the diff, anyone checking one against the other can't tell what the description means. The maintainer fixed the count when the bot pointed this out.
rules.check: Count the items in the diff (for example, methods made static) and compare with any number in the PR description or CHANGELOG entry. Report a mismatch and ask which members the stated number covers.
